question: What information does UMD require in the employer offer letter for a CPT application?
relevant_passage: Obtain an internship/co-op offer letter from an employer which includes all of the following information:
expected_key_facts: Official company letterhead
An authorized signature
Specific internship/co-op start and end dates
Hours per week
Workplace address; both employer and work-site addresses if different; no PO Box addresses
Amount of compensation
Specific job responsibilities
Supervisor name
For master's thesis or Ph.D. students in their research phase, an employer statement that the work will be incorporated into thesis/dissertation research
ambiguities: The source says 'The specific term internship or co-op'; preserve this wording or flag its ambiguity rather than confidently interpreting it.

question: What does UMD require for documenting remote work in a CPT application?
relevant_passage: Any student working remotely on CPT must have this confirmed in the offer letter or in supporting documentation, the address where you will work remotely must also be mentioned by the employer.
expected_key_facts: Remote work must be confirmed in the offer letter OR supporting documentation
The employer must mention the address where the student will work remotely

question: My CPT application is submitted. Can I start working before receiving the updated I-20?
relevant_passage: You do not have the authorization to begin working until you receive this I-20 showing the employment authorization on the second page.
expected_key_facts: Submitting an application does not authorize work
The student must receive the I-20 showing employment authorization on page 2 before beginning work

question: How long does UMD typically take to process a complete CPT request?
relevant_passage: ISSS processes all requests for CPT as quickly as possible and typically within 3-5 business days. Requests are processed in the order they are received so as not to disadvantage other students who are in a similar rush to receive their authorization.
expected_key_facts: Typical processing time is 3–5 business days
Requests are processed in the order received
Typical processing time is not a guaranteed completion date

question: Does UMD authorize CPT for remote work performed outside the United States?
relevant_passage: Students must be physically present in the US during the CPT experience. CPT cannot be authorized for remote work that the student will conduct from outside the US.
expected_key_facts: The snapshot requires physical presence in the United States during CPT
The snapshot says CPT cannot authorize remote work performed outside the United States

question: What additional CPT eligibility requirement applies after changing degree programs?
relevant_passage: Students who change degree programs must complete one semester in the new program and receive a qualifying GPA before applying for CPT.
expected_key_facts: Complete one semester in the new degree program
Receive a qualifying GPA before applying
These conditions alone do not establish that every CPT eligibility requirement is met

question: Is attending UMD's CPT workshop mandatory before applying?
relevant_passage: Please note that your attendance at this workshop is not required in order to apply for CPT.
expected_key_facts: Workshop attendance is not required to apply for CPT

question: What conditions does UMD list for waiving winter internship-course registration for a continuing internship?
expected_key_facts: All three listed conditions must be met
Same employer from Fall through Winter, or from Winter through the duration of Spring
Same weekly hours throughout the internship
At application, the offer letter specifies full internship dates including winter employment
The waiver concerns winter course registration, not a waiver of CPT authorization
